description: Bela piezo disc sensor — analog input with DC filtering and onset detection
notes: Analog must be enabled in the Bela IDE (Settings → Analog) for analogRead() to work.
sampleRate 'half' = 22.05 kHz (one analog sample per 2 audio frames).
Connect piezo signal through 100k series R to analog header pin 0 (channel 0).
Connect 1 MΩ bleed resistor from the same signal node to GND.
Bela analog input range: 0 V – 4.096 V (12-bit ADC, normalized to 0.0–1.0).
Do not exceed 1.8 V on BeagleBone GPIO — the Bela frontend conditions the signal, but large piezo strikes can spike above 4 V. The 100k series R limits transient current.
